name: Lou's Potion
source:
You're on a blind date with a man who works at a diner, but there's something suspicious about him and the special drink he prepares for the two of you. Will you trust him or perhaps uncover his secrets and turn the tables around?

[From [url=https://zyferr.itch.io/lous-potion]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你正在和一个在餐馆工作的男人相亲，但他和他为你们两个准备的特殊饮料有些可疑。你会相信他，还是会揭开他的秘密并扭转局面？

[来自[url=https://zyferr.itch.io/lous-potion]Itch.io[/url]]
